entries.name: Pixel
entries.description: Image artist agent. Crafts prompts, iterates on outputs, owns visual quality.
useCases: Generate on-brand social and marketing images
Iterate on visual concepts until they land
Own image quality across your asset library

entries.name: Rolo
entries.description: Video producer agent. Generates video + audio, mixes finished assets.
useCases: Produce short-form video from a brief
Generate and mix audio tracks
Assemble finished cuts into your asset library

entries.name: Jessica
entries.description: Research agent — multi-source discovery, evidence gathering, synthesis support.
useCases: Deep-dive a market, competitor, or topic
Gather and cross-check evidence from many sources
Turn raw findings into a synthesized brief

entries.name: Patch
entries.description: Developer agent — API integrations, automation, debugging, tool extensions.
useCases: Wire up API integrations and webhooks
Automate repetitive technical chores
Debug failures and extend agent tooling

entries.name: H'enrich
entries.description: Vision utility agent — captions, OCR, and tags for asset search. Powers zero-config enrichment; not dispatchable, no channels.
useCases: Auto-caption and tag every image you save
OCR screenshots so their text is searchable
Keep asset search rich without lifting a finger

entries.name: Messaging
entries.description: Content planning, calendar items, brainstorming sessions, approvals, and channel delivery.
useCases: Plan a week of posts on a content calendar
Route drafts through an approval gate
Deliver approved content to channels

entries.name: Projects
entries.description: Project specs, checklists, task links, assets, and project-context agent tools.
useCases: Keep specs, checklists, and tasks in one place
Link agent work back to the project it serves
Give agents project context automatically

entries.name: Web Search (Brave)
entries.description: Lets your agents search the web — fresh information, documentation, and news, read straight from the page and cited back to their sources. No browser required.
useCases: Research tasks that need current information
Documentation and troubleshooting lookups
Grounding agent output in cited sources

entries.name: YouTube Transcripts
entries.description: Lets your agents read YouTube videos — pull the transcript of any captioned video for notes, summaries, and research. No audio processing, no API key.
useCases: Summarize talks and tutorials from a link
Pull quotes and timestamps from a video
Research topics covered in video form

entries.name: Audio Transcription
entries.description: Lets your agents turn audio and video files into text — meetings, voice memos, recordings — fully local, no API key, nothing leaves the box.
useCases: Transcribe a meeting recording and pull action items
Turn voice memos into notes
Make audio/video content searchable

entries.name: OCR (Apple Vision)
entries.description: Lets your agents read text out of images, screenshots, and scanned PDFs — receipts, forms, whiteboard photos — fully local via Apple's Vision framework. No API key, nothing leaves the box.
useCases: Read a scanned PDF or receipt a chat attachment points at
Pull exact text (amounts, serial numbers) out of screenshots
Make photographed documents quotable without vision tokens

entries.name: Browser Tools
entries.description: Lets your agents drive a real Chrome browser — open pages, read what actually renders, run JavaScript, take screenshots, and extract article text.
useCases: Read JS-heavy pages that plain fetching can't see
Screenshot a page to verify what it renders
Extract clean article text from cluttered sites

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: Lets your agents work GitHub the way you do — read issues and pull requests, watch CI runs, inspect diffs, and open PRs — through the official `gh` command line tool.
useCases: Triage open issues and summarize what changed
Watch a CI run and report which check failed
Draft a pull request from a finished branch

entries.name: Notion
entries.description: Lets your agents read and write your Notion workspace — search pages, pull a doc's content as text, append notes, and query databases. Nothing to install; just connect a key.
useCases: Pull a spec out of Notion before starting work
Append meeting notes to a running page
Query a project database for what is in flight

entries.name: Word & Excel Documents
entries.description: Lets your agents read and write real Word and Excel files — pull the text out of a .docx, turn a spreadsheet into data they can reason over, and hand back a formatted document or workbook. Fully local, no Office install, no API key.
useCases: Read a .docx someone attached and act on what it says
Turn a spreadsheet into numbers an agent can reason over
Hand back a formatted report or workbook as a deliverable

entries.name: Google Workspace
entries.description: Lets your agents work your Google account — search Gmail, read and add calendar events, find files in Drive, and read or update Sheets and Docs — through the open-source `gog` command line tool.
useCases: Search this week's mail for what needs a reply
Check the calendar before scheduling anything
Read or update a Google Sheet in place

entries.name: Skill Porter
entries.description: Sharpens `bakin skills map` — teaches your agent where skill bundles actually hide their API keys and command-line prerequisites, so an installed skill's readiness reflects what it really needs instead of guesses.
useCases: Map an installed hub skill's requirements more accurately
Catch the API key a pasted skill never declared
Keep readiness honest for skills from outside ClawHub
